title: Experiences of chronic pain patients with the external perception of their pain pain in their social, professional, and medical environments
summary: On the one hand, this exploratory study aims to determine how often patients experience doubts about their pain report in their medical family or professional environment. On the other hand, data should be collected about whether and to what extent these influence the pain experience and the mood of the patients as well as the trust of the patients in their environment
conditions: Chronic pain disorder with somatic and psychological factors

interventions.name:
One-time survey using a questionnaire: Experiences of chronic pain patients with the perception of their pain in their social, professionalo and medical environments.

We are collecting data on the experiences of patients with chronic pain regarding how others perceive their pain in professional,
